title: Account Coordinator
Office Coordinator
description:
Office Coordinator

Location: Hull
Salary: 27,000 - 28,000 per annum (dependent on experience)
Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:00am - 4:30pm, Friday 8:00am - 1:00pm

The Company

Our client is a well-established specialist manufacturer whose products and associated service plans are supplied to customers across the globe. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit an organised and proactive Office Coordinator to support a range of business functions and play a key role in the day-to-day running of the office.

The Role

As Office Coordinator, you will provide administrative support across multiple departments, helping to ensure projects, installations, customer requirements and internal processes are managed efficiently.

This is a varied position that would suit an individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and takes pride in delivering excellent support to both customers and colleagues.

Key Responsibilities
- Preparing and compiling accurate installation and project documentation
- Coordinating travel arrangements, including booking flights, hotels and transport for engineers and management teams
- Processing employee expense claims and maintaining accurate records
- Supporting customers with enquiries and providing a professional point of contact
- Assisting colleagues across various departments with administration and coordination tasks
- Maintaining customer records, documentation and filing systems
- Organising meetings and supporting diary management where required
- Producing reports, correspondence and general business documentation
- Supporting the smooth running of office operations and business processes
- Ensuring all paperwork is completed accurately and within required timescales

The Person

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, detail-focused and confident managing multiple priorities.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Office Coordinator, Office Administrator, Administration or Business Support role
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- A professional and customer-focused approach
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Experience arranging travel and processing expenses would be advantageous
- Experience within a manufacturing, engineering or technical environment would be beneficial, although not essential

What's On Offer?
- Salary of 27,000 - 28,000 per annum
- Early finish every Friday
- Stable Monday to Friday working hours
- Varied and interesting role supporting international operations
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Opportunity to develop within a growing specialist manufacturing business

If you are an organised and proactive administrator looking for a varied role within a successful manufacturing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Treasury Administrator
description:
Who we are

GlobalData operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organisations see what s coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.

Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organisations across the world s largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Why join GlobalData?

GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey, and we need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision to deliver intelligence that transforms uncertainty into opportunity for the world s most successful organisations.?

Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData is fast-paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. Working together in an intellectually challenging environment, where learning is super-charged to keep us on our toes, the highly stimulating, fast-paced, global environment we operate in, and our bold ambitions result in unique learning opportunities for our people.

The role

We now have an opening for a Treasury Administrator within the Treasury Team based in Hull. Working within the finance team, we expect you to have close interaction with the wider commercial business, with the main responsibility being production of daily bank reconciliations and processing of payments.

Now is an incredibly exciting time to join and be part of a business that is fast-paced, vibrant and ambitious, with opportunities for everyone to develop and succeed.

What you ll be doing
- Producing daily bank reconciliations in multi currencies
- Cash allocation of bank receipts and payments
- Resolving cash allocation queries
- Ledger maintenance
- Liaising with purchase ledger, credit control
- Creation of manual purchase ledger payments
- Bank and credit card administration

What we re looking for
- AAT Qualified, or experience of working in a similar role.
- Technical skills - with strong Excel skills and analytical ability.
- Dedicated and accountable - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail and effectively managing expectations.
- Organised - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail as well as managing expectations effectively.
- A strong communicator - able to communicate well and build strong, collaborative relationships across the business.
- Adaptable and positive mindset - a confident personality with a positive attitude towards change and new challenges.
